parameters.name: visible
parameters.doc: Optional; if omitted or nil, no close button is shown.

elements.name: imgui.begin_popup_context_item
elements.description:
BeginPopupContextItem.
If id is omitted, uses the last item ID (same as ImGui helper behavior). Lua - call with no arguments to use the last item; passing nil is not accepted.

parameters.name: id
parameters.doc: Optional; if omitted, uses the last item ID.

parameters.name: style_var
parameters.doc: Enum for the style to be pushed

parameters.name: value
parameters.doc: Number or vmath.vector3 specifying the value of the style var

parameters.name: count
parameters.doc: Number of style vars to pop; optional, defaults to 1

elements.name: imgui.TABLECOLUMN_WIDTHSTRETCH

elements.description: TABLECOLUMN_WIDTHFIXED Column will not stretch. Preferable with horizontal scrolling enabled (default if table sizing policy is _SizingFixedFit and table is resizable).

elements.description: TABLECOLUMN_NOSORT Disable ability to sort on this field (even if ImGuiTableFlags_Sortable is set on the table).

elements.description: TABLE_BORDERSINNERV Draw vertical borders between columns.

elements.name: imgui.TABLE_SIZINGFIXEDFIT
elements.brief: TABLE_SIZINGFIXEDFIT Columns default to _WidthFixed or _WidthAuto (if resizable or not resizable), matching contents width.
elements.description: TABLE_SIZINGFIXEDFIT Columns default to _WidthFixed or _WidthAuto (if resizable or not resizable), matching contents width.

elements.name: imgui.TABLE_SIZINGFIXEDSAME
elements.brief: TABLE_SIZINGFIXEDSAME Columns default to _WidthFixed or _WidthAuto (if resizable or not resizable), matching the maximum contents width of all columns. Implicitly enable ImGuiTableFlags_NoKeepColumnsVisible.
elements.description: TABLE_SIZINGFIXEDSAME Columns default to _WidthFixed or _WidthAuto (if resizable or not resizable), matching the maximum contents width of all columns. Implicitly enable ImGuiTableFlags_NoKeepColumnsVisible.

elements.name: imgui.TABLE_SIZINGSTRETCHPROP
elements.brief: TABLE_SIZINGSTRETCHPROP Columns default to _WidthStretch with default weights proportional to each columns contents widths.
elements.description: TABLE_SIZINGSTRETCHPROP Columns default to _WidthStretch with default weights proportional to each columns contents widths.

elements.name: imgui.TABLE_SIZINGSTRETCHSAME
elements.brief: TABLE_SIZINGSTRETCHSAME Columns default to _WidthStretch with default weights all equal, unless overriden by TableSetupColumn().
elements.description: TABLE_SIZINGSTRETCHSAME Columns default to _WidthStretch with default weights all equal, unless overriden by TableSetupColumn().

elements.name: imgui.TABLE_NOHOSTEXTENDX
elements.brief: TABLE_NOHOSTEXTENDX Make outer width auto-fit to columns, overriding outer_size.x value. Only available when ScrollX/ScrollY are disabled and Stretch columns are not used.
elements.description: TABLE_NOHOSTEXTENDX Make outer width auto-fit to columns, overriding outer_size.x value. Only available when ScrollX/ScrollY are disabled and Stretch columns are not used.

elements.name: imgui.TABLE_NOHOSTEXTENDY
elements.brief: TABLE_NOHOSTEXTENDY Make outer height stop exactly at outer_size.y (prevent auto-extending table past the limit). Only available when ScrollX/ScrollY are disabled. Data below the limit will be clipped and not visible.
elements.description: TABLE_NOHOSTEXTENDY Make outer height stop exactly at outer_size.y (prevent auto-extending table past the limit). Only available when ScrollX/ScrollY are disabled. Data below the limit will be clipped and not visible.

elements.name: imgui.TABLE_NOKEEPCOLUMNSVISIBLE
elements.brief: TABLE_NOKEEPCOLUMNSVISIBLE Disable keeping column always minimally visible when ScrollX is off and table gets too small. Not recommended if columns are resizable.
elements.description: TABLE_NOKEEPCOLUMNSVISIBLE Disable keeping column always minimally visible when ScrollX is off and table gets too small. Not recommended if columns are resizable.

elements.name: imgui.TABLE_PRECISEWIDTHS
elements.brief: TABLE_PRECISEWIDTHS Disable distributing remainder width to stretched columns (width allocation on a 100-wide table with 3 columns: Without this flag: 33,33,34. With this flag: 33,33,33). With larger number of columns, resizing will appear to be less smooth.
elements.description: TABLE_PRECISEWIDTHS Disable distributing remainder width to stretched columns (width allocation on a 100-wide table with 3 columns: Without this flag: 33,33,34. With this flag: 33,33,33). With larger number of columns, resizing will appear to be less smooth.

elements.name: imgui.TABLE_NOCLIP
elements.brief: TABLE_NOCLIP Disable clipping rectangle for every individual columns (reduce draw command count, items will be able to overflow into other columns). Generally incompatible with TableSetupScrollFreeze().
elements.description: TABLE_NOCLIP Disable clipping rectangle for every individual columns (reduce draw command count, items will be able to overflow into other columns). Generally incompatible with TableSetupScrollFreeze().

elements.name: imgui.TABLE_PADOUTERX
elements.brief: TABLE_PADOUTERX Default if BordersOuterV is on. Enable outer-most padding. Generally desirable if you have headers.
elements.description: TABLE_PADOUTERX Default if BordersOuterV is on. Enable outer-most padding. Generally desirable if you have headers.

elements.name: imgui.TABLE_NOPADOUTERX
elements.brief: TABLE_NOPADOUTERX Default if BordersOuterV is off. Disable outer-most padding.
elements.description: TABLE_NOPADOUTERX Default if BordersOuterV is off. Disable outer-most padding.

elements.name: imgui.TABLE_NOPADINNERX
elements.brief: TABLE_NOPADINNERX Disable inner padding between columns (double inner padding if BordersOuterV is on, single inner padding if BordersOuterV is off).
elements.description: TABLE_NOPADINNERX Disable inner padding between columns (double inner padding if BordersOuterV is on, single inner padding if BordersOuterV is off).

elements.name: imgui.TABLE_SCROLLX
elements.brief: TABLE_SCROLLX Enable horizontal scrolling. Require 'outer_size' parameter of BeginTable() to specify the container size. Changes default sizing policy. Because this create a child window, ScrollY is currently generally recommended when using ScrollX.
elements.description: TABLE_SCROLLX Enable horizontal scrolling. Require 'outer_size' parameter of BeginTable() to specify the container size. Changes default sizing policy. Because this create a child window, ScrollY is currently generally recommended when using ScrollX.

elements.name: imgui.TABLE_SCROLLY
elements.brief: TABLE_SCROLLY Enable vertical scrolling. Require 'outer_size' parameter of BeginTable() to specify the container size.
elements.description: TABLE_SCROLLY Enable vertical scrolling. Require 'outer_size' parameter of BeginTable() to specify the container size.

elements.name: imgui.TABLE_SORTMULTI
elements.brief: TABLE_SORTMULTI Hold shift when clicking headers to sort on multiple column. TableGetSortSpecs() may return specs where (SpecsCount > 1).
elements.description: TABLE_SORTMULTI Hold shift when clicking headers to sort on multiple column. TableGetSortSpecs() may return specs where (SpecsCount > 1).

elements.name: imgui.TABLE_SORTTRISTATE
elements.brief: TABLE_SORTTRISTATE Allow no sorting, disable default sorting. TableGetSortSpecs() may return specs where (SpecsCount == 0).
elements.description: TABLE_SORTTRISTATE Allow no sorting, disable default sorting. TableGetSortSpecs() may return specs where (SpecsCount == 0).

elements.description: WINDOWFLAGS_NOSAVEDSETTINGS Never load/save settings in .ini file

elements.description: WINDOWFLAGS_NOBRINGTOFRONTONFOCUS Disable bringing window to front when taking focus (e.g. clicking on it or programmatically giving it focus)

elements.brief: WINDOWFLAGS_ALWAYSVERTICALSCROLLBAR Always show vertical scrollbar (even if ContentSize.y < Size.y)

elements.brief: WINDOWFLAGS_ALWAYSUSEWINDOWPADDING Ensure child windows without border uses style.WindowPadding (ignored by default for non-bordered child windows, because more convenient)
elements.description: WINDOWFLAGS_ALWAYSUSEWINDOWPADDING Ensure child windows without border uses style.WindowPadding (ignored by default for non-bordered child windows, because more convenient)

elements.description: WINDOWFLAGS_NONAVFOCUS No focusing toward this window with gamepad/keyboard navigation (e.g. skipped by CTRL+TAB)

elements.name: imgui.WINDOWFLAGS_UNSAVEDDOCUMENT
elements.brief: WINDOWFLAGS_UNSAVEDDOCUMENT Append '*' to title without affecting the ID, as a convenience to avoid using the ### operator. When used in a tab/docking context, tab is selected on closure and closure is deferred by one frame to allow code to cancel the closure (with a confirmation popup, etc.) without flicker.
elements.description: WINDOWFLAGS_UNSAVEDDOCUMENT Append '*' to title without affecting the ID, as a convenience to avoid using the ### operator. When used in a tab/docking context, tab is selected on closure and closure is deferred by one frame to allow code to cancel the closure (with a confirmation popup, etc.) without flicker.

elements.name: imgui.POPUPFLAGS_MOUSEBUTTONLEFT
elements.brief: POPUPFLAGS_MOUSEBUTTONLEFT // For BeginPopupContext*(): open on Left Mouse release. Guaranteed to always be == 0 (same as ImGuiMouseButton_Left)
elements.description: POPUPFLAGS_MOUSEBUTTONLEFT // For BeginPopupContext*(): open on Left Mouse release. Guaranteed to always be == 0 (same as ImGuiMouseButton_Left)

elements.description: POPUPFLAGS_MOUSEBUTTONRIGHT // For BeginPopupContext*(): open on Right Mouse release. Guaranteed to always be == 1 (same as ImGuiMouseButton_Right)

elements.description: POPUPFLAGS_NOOPENOVERITEMS For BeginPopupContextWindow(): don't return true when hovering items, only when hovering empty space

elements.description: POPUPFLAGS_ANYPOPUPID For IsPopupOpen(): ignore the ImGuiID parameter and test for any popup.

elements.description: POPUPFLAGS_ANYPOPUPLEVEL For IsPopupOpen(): search/test at any level of the popup stack (default test in the current level)

elements.name: imgui.DROPFLAGS_SOURCENOPREVIEWTOOLTIP
elements.brief: DROPFLAGS_SOURCENOPREVIEWTOOLTIP By default, a successful call to BeginDragDropSource opens a tooltip so you can display a preview or description of the source contents. This flag disable this behavior.
elements.description: DROPFLAGS_SOURCENOPREVIEWTOOLTIP By default, a successful call to BeginDragDropSource opens a tooltip so you can display a preview or description of the source contents. This flag disable this behavior.

elements.name: imgui.DROPFLAGS_SOURCENODISABLEHOVER
elements.brief: DROPFLAGS_SOURCENODISABLEHOVER By default, when dragging we clear data so that IsItemHovered() will return false, to avoid subsequent user code submitting tooltips. This flag disable this behavior so you can still call IsItemHovered() on the source item.
elements.description: DROPFLAGS_SOURCENODISABLEHOVER By default, when dragging we clear data so that IsItemHovered() will return false, to avoid subsequent user code submitting tooltips. This flag disable this behavior so you can still call IsItemHovered() on the source item.

elements.name: imgui.DROPFLAGS_SOURCENOHOLDTOOPENOTHERS
elements.brief: DROPFLAGS_SOURCENOHOLDTOOPENOTHERS Disable the behavior that allows to open tree nodes and collapsing header by holding over them while dragging a source item.
elements.description: DROPFLAGS_SOURCENOHOLDTOOPENOTHERS Disable the behavior that allows to open tree nodes and collapsing header by holding over them while dragging a source item.

elements.name: imgui.DROPFLAGS_SOURCEALLOWNULLID
elements.brief: DROPFLAGS_SOURCEALLOWNULLID Allow items such as Text(), Image() that have no unique identifier to be used as drag source, by manufacturing a temporary identifier based on their window-relative position. This is extremely unusual within the dear imgui ecosystem and so we made it explicit.
elements.description: DROPFLAGS_SOURCEALLOWNULLID Allow items such as Text(), Image() that have no unique identifier to be used as drag source, by manufacturing a temporary identifier based on their window-relative position. This is extremely unusual within the dear imgui ecosystem and so we made it explicit.

elements.name: imgui.DROPFLAGS_SOURCEEXTERN
elements.brief: DROPFLAGS_SOURCEEXTERN External source (from outside of dear imgui), won't attempt to read current item/window info. Will always return true. Only one Extern source can be active simultaneously.
elements.description: DROPFLAGS_SOURCEEXTERN External source (from outside of dear imgui), won't attempt to read current item/window info. Will always return true. Only one Extern source can be active simultaneously.

elements.name: imgui.DROPFLAGS_SOURCEAUTOEXPIREPAYLOAD

elements.description: DROPFLAGS_SOURCEAUTOEXPIREPAYLOAD Automatically expire the payload if the source cease to be submitted (otherwise payloads are persisting while being dragged)

elements.name: imgui.INPUTFLAGS_CALLBACKRESIZE
elements.brief: INPUTFLAGS_CALLBACKRESIZE Callback on buffer capacity changes request (beyond 'buf_size' parameter value), allowing the string to grow. Notify when the string wants to be resized (for string types which hold a cache of their Size). You will be provided a new BufSize in the callback and NEED to honor it. (see misc/cpp/imgui_stdlib.h for an example of using this)
